longDescription: This sample lists sites from SharePoint Search, reads live risk signals from each site with the signed-in user's own access, and lets site owners record an attestation. Scores are a configurable sample heuristic, not a Microsoft score. It never changes site permissions or sharing links. Localization covers English, Bahasa Indonesia, and Simplified Chinese, following the user's display language.
name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-copilot-oversharing-readiness

references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework. You can also use modern JavaScript web frameworks, tools, and libraries to build them.
references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part

shortDescription: Read-only SharePoint web part that reviews site sharing risk before a Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout, with a configurable sample score, owner attestation, and CSV export.
title: Copilot Oversharing Readiness
